'''Patijak Sonn''' was the [[Author/Legends|author]] of the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[Kholemi Elaru]]'', which was published at some point<ref name="HNN" /> by [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45||A Closer Look}} is set on the date 13:2:28, which corresponds to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> For a [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="HNN" /> in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> it was the fourth best-selling book on a list published by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News's]] [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:2:28.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45||A Closer Look}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Patijak Sonn was mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 45|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #45]], a<ref name="HNN" /> [[February 28]], [[2002]],<ref name="HNN45 date">Per {{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072556/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-4#post-6042498}}, [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] was released on [[March 14]], [[2002]]. As [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] segments were published weekly, and {{Hnn|45||A Closer Look}} was published two issues prior, it must have been released on [[February 28]] of the same year.</ref> issue of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]].<ref name="HNN" /> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]] wrote the site content.<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
